questions.q: Why is treating security as a late-stage task, configured only after the 'real' functional design is finished, considered a mistake?
options: Because security has no connection to functional design decisions
Because Oracle Fusion does not allow security to be configured after functional design
Because security can only be configured before any other setup work begins
Because security decisions are embedded in the functional design itself, such as enterprise structure decisions directly shaping data access sets and business unit contexts
questions.explain: Enterprise structure decisions (business units, ledgers) made early in design directly determine the data access sets and business unit security contexts covered in Chapter 2 — security is not separable from functional design.

questions.q: During which implementation phase does this lesson say segregation-of-duties review is cheapest to perform?
options: After go-live, once real tickets start arriving
SoD review timing makes no difference to cost
During role design, before people are provisioned the wrong combination of roles
Only during the external audit
questions.explain: Reviewing for SoD conflicts during role design is far cheaper than discovering and correcting conflicts after fifty people have already been provisioned.

questions.q: What does a dedicated security test cycle verify that is distinct from ordinary functional testing?
options: Only whether the user interface loads quickly
That each role grants exactly the expected function access, that data security produces expected rows, that role mappings work correctly, and that no unapproved SoD conflicts exist
Only whether invoices calculate tax correctly
Only whether the chart of accounts is formatted correctly
questions.explain: A security test cycle specifically verifies function access correctness, data security outcomes, provisioning rule behavior, and the absence of unapproved SoD conflicts before go-live.

questions.q: What is run as a pre-go-live baseline during the cutover phase, according to this lesson?
options: The User and Role Access Audit Report
A full re-installation of Oracle Fusion
A customer satisfaction survey
The chart of accounts validation report
questions.explain: The User and Role Access Audit Report, introduced in Lesson 14, is run as a baseline before go-live to confirm role assignments are clean.

questions.q: Which course comes next in the Security & Implementation stage of the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant path, after Oracle Fusion Security?
options: Troubleshooting Oracle Financials
SQL for Oracle Financials
Oracle Fusion Accounts Payable
Oracle Fusion Implementation Lifecycle
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Implementation Lifecycle is the next course in the Security & Implementation stage, zooming out to the full implementation project that these security decisions live inside.
